top_signals.title: Berkshire Hathaway Plans First Japan Bond Offering Since April
top_signals.summary: Berkshire Hathaway Inc. has hired banks for its first yen bond sale since April, according to people familiar with the matter, as it prepares to raise more funds in Japan.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Lula Vows Fiscal Responsibility in First Address Since Election
top_signals.summary: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva pledged to preserve Brazil’s public finances without abandoning social programs in his first televised address since winning a fourth term, as he sought to reassure investors.
